def ode(Y, t, params, cell_positions):
    A, B = Y[:, 0], Y[:, 1]
    p = params
    dY = np.zeros_like(Y, dtype=float)
    dY[:, 0] = p['alpha'] / (1 + (B / p['K'])**p['h']) - p['gamma_A'] * A
    dY[:, 1] = p['k'] * A - p['gamma_B'] * B
    return dY
